author: PBS Space Time
description:
What if the fundamental building blocks of reality aren't particles, but tiny vibrating strings hidden within extra dimensions of space? We explore how string theory could unite quantum mechanics and general relativity, why it might hold the key to quantum gravity, and why physicists still debate whether it's a true description of our universe.
